title: task-context
description: What a task runner (a terminal multiplexer, CI, a person by hand: any of them) hands `knowledge context`, `knowledge check` and `knowledge decision put` as --task-file. The harness only reads the file. `task_id` and `workspace_id` are names without meaning to the harness: they are checked for length and characters only, and no ticket id is parsed out of them.

principal.description: Who searches: a principal of knowledge/config.json.

base_sha.description: The commit the work starts from (SHA-1 or SHA-256), when there is one.

path.description: A path relative to the repository root: no leading '/', no '.' or '..' segment, no backslash, no control character.
